We deliver this as Robots as a Service, so operators pay for outcomes with no capital expenditure. 

Founded in Melbourne by engineers with a combined decade building robots, Ampere is purpose built for Australian solar. We are accepting founding operators for early pilots.

Stream data off your robots, store it at a fraction of the cost, and analyse it in plain English.

Alloy replaces that stack:
1. Capture: edge agent streams data off your robots automatically, no silent failures.
2. Store: robotics-native storage, no egress fees, cheaper than S3.
3. Understand: chat with your fleet data in plain English, find root causes in minutes.
4. Track: monitors every mission for regressions, so every deployment improves your robot.
5. Integrate: pipes insights into the tools you use like Jira, Slack, Grafana and your CI pipeline.
6. Resolve: auto-triage tickets so you can respond to customers faster.

Every mission makes your Alloy agent smarter. 
Your fleet's history becomes institutional knowledge that any engineer can tap into via MCP, Slack or the platform.

About Us

FlyFarm is pioneering a new frontier in sustainable bio-manufacturing by transforming insects into miniature biofactories.

Our proprietary automation, climate control, and AI-driven production technologies enable scalable, cost-effective BSF operations, even in challenging environments.

Name: Robotic Surf Life Saving
Description:
The RoboDucky, it's designed to enhance and extend the capabilities of lifeguards by combining the ease of use of traditional rescue equipment with the speed of high-powered rescue craft without a lengthy deployment time.

It has a sitting duck mode which is a GPS station hold. This enables a lifeguard to deploy it at the start of the day and park it behind the surf ready to be mobilised instantly. The RoboDucky gives lifeguards a headstart in a rescue. 

The RoboDucky can travel at over 35 kilometres an hour and a has been able to tow multiple people weighing over 270kg all while being fully operational by just one remote person. Its durable soft hull protects its internal components and can comfortably navigate through 12 foot surf with ease.
